triggers.desc: Any string property without a more specific renderer (`enum`, `format: date`, `markdown`, `typeahead`, `file`... have their own).

type.desc: Input type of the underlying `QInput`, overriding the schema `format` (`text`, `textarea`, `password`, `email`, `search`, `tel`, `url`, `number`...).

rows.desc: Number of rows; when greater than 1 the input is a `textarea`.

wordLimit.desc: Word count limit, `"min:max"` or a maximum; a word counter is displayed under the input.

….desc: Any other option is passed as a prop to [QInput](https://quasar.dev/vue-components/input#qinput-api): `outlined`, `filled`, `dense`, `clearable`, `autocomplete`, `maxlength`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `mask`...

wordLimit.desc: `wordLimit: "min:max"` not satisfied (`{min}`, `{max}` available in the message); `validationMessage.wordLimitError` on the control.

data.desc: The text as typed. An emptied input stores `undefined` rather than `""`, so that `required` applies. Schema keywords `minLength`, `maxLength`, `pattern` and `format` (`email`, `uri`...) are validated by AJV.
